name: MNRB Holdings Berhad
summary: MNRB Holdings Berhad, an investment holding company, engages in the general reinsurance, takaful, and retakaful businesses in Malaysia and internationally. It offers general reinsurance; financial protection services; and general takaful solutions, such as motor and non-motor general takaful protection products. The company also distributes its products through agents, brokers, financial institutions, motor franchise holders, and co-operatives, as well as a digital platform.
